disclaimer: Mock approval policy for the FundSentinel hackathon demo. Internal decision support only; not investment advice and not any real firm's policy.

finance.note: Fail above max_expense_ratio. Concern if the fee is more than 25% above the category average.

analyst.note: Concern if 5y return trails the category by more than 2 points. A 1y return above 100% is treated as a data problem, not good performance.

compliance.note: Any compliance fail means the fund is rejected (Decision owner layer 1). Fund size is converted to USD with config/fx.json.

suitability.note: Risk 5 funds can only be approved with conditions (restricted to experienced investors).
